title: Glow Glass
description: This mod allows you to create beautiful glass blocks that glow! The glass blocks can act as a source of light for your builds!
body:
# **Welcome**
This mod allows you to create beautiful glass blocks that glow! The glass blocks can act as a source of light for your building!

I decided to make this because I hated using torches and oil lamps / lanterns etc. to decorate my home.

To craft the glow glass in survival mode, you need to use 2 glass blocks and 1 torch next to each other, in the pattern glass block, torch, glass block.

In version 2.0.0:

Glow Glass blocks are also toggable now by left clicking the block. The current state of the block is also shown upon interaction.

Dynamic lighting when torch in offhand!

## **Features**

- Maximum illumination (equal to torch)
- Clean looks for your builds
- Toggable with left click
- Torch in offhand offers dynamic lighting
- Survival friendly (easy to craft)
- Compatible with Minecraft 26.1.x
